auditMetadata.overallPedagogicalScore: 78/100 (Exceptional in Scientific streams, Broken in Literary streams)

step1_diagnostic.name: Diagnostic Assessment (التشخيص الأولي)
step1_diagnostic.findings: Functional test runners in place. Diagnostic results correctly compute gap profiles in Sciences Exp and Gestion. Lettres & Philo suffers from an inadequate pool (3 items only).

step2_gap_identification.name: Gap Identification & Attribution (تحديد الثغرات)
step2_gap_identification.findings: Distractor selections in diagnostic are mapped to specific skill deficiencies and cognitive flags (e.g. calculation_error, formula_confusion).

step3_mission_dispatch.name: Remediation Mission Dispatch (إسناد المهمة العلاجية)
step3_mission_dispatch.findings: Student dashboard features a prominent 'المهمة الموصى بها حالياً' (Current Recommended Mission) card targeting the weakest skill.

step4_lesson_and_worked_example.name: Instructional Phase: Lesson & Worked Example (الدرس والمثال النموذجي)
step4_lesson_and_worked_example.findings: In Sciences Exp, every skill includes concise theoretical summaries with KaTeX mathematical formulas and a step-by-step worked example with commentary on common pitfalls.

step5_practice_testing.name: Formative Practice Testing (التمرين التطبيقي المؤقت)
step5_practice_testing.findings: Sciences Exp questions are well-timed with authentic distractors. Gestion & Économie suffers from placeholder mock options ('خيار بديل opt_b').

step6_error_classification.name: Error Classification & Cognitive Lab (مختبر الأخطاء وتصنيف المفاهيم الخاطئة)
step6_error_classification.findings: Error Lab accurately captures failure timestamps, selected option, and maps to the error taxonomy (misconception, sign_error, formula_inversion).

step7_cognitive_repair.name: Cognitive Repair Guide (دليل الترميم المعرفي)
step7_cognitive_repair.findings: Repair guides do not simply reveal the correct answer; they explain the underlying mental model flaw, provide actionable checklist steps, and present contrastive problems.

step8_isomorphic_retest.name: Isomorphic Retest Twin (إعادة الاختبار التوأم)
step8_isomorphic_retest.findings: Retest questions maintain the identical cognitive depth while altering numbers/parameters. However, in Gestion & Économie, retest options are hardcoded as 'الإجابة الصحيحة' and 'إجابة خاطئة شائعة'.

step9_mastery_certification.name: Mastery Verification & Progression (تأكيد الإتقان وتحديث التقدم)
step9_mastery_certification.findings: Successfully passing the retest awards skill mastery, increments the student's mastery radar chart, and unlocks the next prerequisite skill.

curriculumAlignment.mathBatch01PackageRigor: OUTSTANDING (Full proof steps, algebraic verification, TVI conditions)
curriculumAlignment.pedagogicalWeakness: Literary and Foreign Language streams have been completely neglected, creating severe product inequality between scientific and literary students.
